matching: Items 1-2 gap-fill: room from an activity; 3-4 choice matching activity to room; EC = Arabic-transfer room label/collocation errors ('sleeping room', 'eating room', 'path room') replaced by the English room word; FP = one sentence matching a named room to an activity; transfer = a house-tour/plan description. All words EVP A1, prompts 9-14 words. Item order identical across forms: 1-2 controlled gap-fill, 3-4 controlled choice, 5-6 error correction, 7-8 free production (target_form_0_1_2), 9 transfer. Review round 3: C-2 ('family sits together', several right rooms; also repeated C-9 living room) replaced by a kitchen clue, parallel to A-1/B-2. Review round 4: C-9 advert no longer shows 'bathrooms' (the C-1 key and C-5 correction). Review round 5: no item's answer word is shown elsewhere in its form (slot 3-4 options and slot 7-8 named rooms use only rooms that are not keyed or corrected in that form; advert lines no longer show 'bedrooms'). B-5 'cooking room' (no Arabic calque) -> 'eating room' (dining room); B-6 double error 'sitting room of guests' -> single p/b slip 'path room' (bathroom). C-9 prompt 'One or two words' (accepts lounge).
